John Keats' "To Autumn," animated entirely in code 🍂

Gemini 4 Neon built this 3D animation in pure vanilla JavaScript with no external libraries — painting every frame and syncing the narration and ambient audio across all three stanzas. https://t.co/w4ZJZ1xD1T
